title: Eat Time
body:
# Eat Time

![Version](https://img.shields.io/badge/Minecraft-1.20.6-green) ![Loader](https://img.shields.io/badge/Loader-Fabric-blue) ![Status](https://img.shields.io/badge/Status-WIP-brightgreen)

---

Eat Time is a mod that prevents the player from wasting food outside of the normal human feeding cycle. This mod can be useful for roleplayers. Food perishability will be added soon.

---

## Installation

1. Install the **Fabric Loader** for Minecraft **1.20.6**.
2. Download the [**Fabric API**](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api/version/0.100.8+1.20.6) and drop it into your `mods` folder.
3. Drop the **Ear-time** `.jar` into the same `mods` folder.
